name: Brifentanil
summary: Brifentanil (A-3331) is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of fentanyl and was developed in the early 1990s. Brifentanil is most similar to highly potent, short-acting fentanyl analogues such as alfentanil. The effects of brifentanil are very similar to those of alfentanil, with strong but short lasting analgesia and sedation, and particularly notable itching and respiratory depression.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening.

pharmacology.en: Like fentanyl, it acts on the mu-opioid receptor. Activating that receptor dampens pain signals and also slows the brainstem centres that drive breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 和芬太尼一樣，它作用於 μ 鴉片受體。活化該受體會抑制疼痛訊號，同時也減緩驅動呼吸的腦幹中樞。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和芬太尼一样，它作用于 μ 鸦片受体。活化该受体会抑制疼痛信号，同时也减缓驱动呼吸的脑干中枢。

uses.en: It was studied for use in anaesthesia and pain relief during procedures, but was never marketed.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究用於麻醉與手術過程中的止痛，但從未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究用于麻醉与手术过程中的止痛，但从未上市。

fact.en: It was developed in the early 1990s as a very short acting fentanyl analogue, in the same mould as alfentanil, for use during anaesthesia.
fact.zh: 它於 1990 年代初被開發為作用極短的芬太尼類似物，風格與 alfentanil 相同，供麻醉過程中使用。
fact.zhHans: 它于 1990 年代初被开发为作用极短的芬太尼类似物，风格与 alfentanil 相同，供麻醉过程中使用。
